scripts.merge-reports: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.rmSync('blob-merged',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('blob-merged');for(const d of fs.existsSync('blob-report')?fs.readdirSync('blob-report'):[])for(const f of fs.readdirSync(p.join('blob-report',d)))if(f.endsWith('.zip'))fs.copyFileSync(p.join('blob-report',d,f),p.join('blob-merged',f));" && playwright merge-reports --config playwright.merge.config.ts blob-merged
